Overview.Name: M.Srividya
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) & paneer cubes (50 g)
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (small) & boiled egg (1)
Option 3: Paneer bhurji (70 g) & salad (lighter option)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & paneer curry (80 g) & spinach curry
Option 3: 2 chapati & grilled chicken (moderate portion) & salad (lighter option)
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Since spicy food is a preference, keep spices in home cooked meals instead of choosing fried outside food.
Avoid prawns as mentioned and focus more on chicken and eggs for protein.
Keep lunch slightly stronger to maintain steady energy through the day.
Stress eating can be reduced by eating slowly and keeping snack options simple like makhana.
Simple home style cooking will help maintain consistency and support long term health.
